chat_access_log_case_check.name: chat_access_log_case_check
chat_access_log_case_check.value: ("chat_access_log"."report_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("chat_access_log"."appeal_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("chat_access_log"."translation_report_id" IS NOT NULL)::int = 1

generated.as: greatest(created_at, coalesce(edited_at, created_at), coalesce(deleted_at, created_at), coalesce(moderated_at, created_at), coalesce(meta_changed_at, created_at))

entries_titled_created_idx.name: entries_titled_created_idx
entries_titled_created_idx.where: "entries"."kind" = 'topic' and "entries"."deleted_at" is null and "entries"."title" is not null

figure_translations_content_check.name: figure_translations_content_check
figure_translations_content_check.value: ("figure_translations"."state" = 'ready' and "figure_translations"."bytes" is not null and octet_length("figure_translations"."bytes") between 1 and 2097152 and "figure_translations"."labels" is not null) or ("figure_translations"."state" = 'skipped' and "figure_translations"."bytes" is null)

glossary_revisions_change_check.name: glossary_revisions_change_check
glossary_revisions_change_check.value: "glossary_revisions"."before" is not null or "glossary_revisions"."after" is not null

invitation_note_translations_ready_check.name: invitation_note_translations_ready_check
invitation_note_translations_ready_check.value: "invitation_note_translations"."state" <> 'ready' OR ("invitation_note_translations"."text" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("invitation_note_translations"."text") BETWEEN 1 AND 600)

invitations_note_check.name: invitations_note_check
invitations_note_check.value: ("invitations"."note" IS NULL AND "invitations"."note_lang" IS NULL) OR ("invitations"."note" IS NOT NULL AND "invitations"."note_lang" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("invitations"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 300)

media_content_check.name: media_content_check
media_content_check.value: ("media"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "media"."bytes" IS NOT NULL AND octet_length("media"."bytes") = "media"."byte_size") OR ("media"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "media"."bytes" IS NULL)

moderation_actions_actor_check.name: moderation_actions_actor_check
moderation_actions_actor_check.value: ("moderation_actions"."automatic" = false AND "moderation_actions"."actor_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("moderation_actions"."automatic" = true AND "moderation_actions"."actor_id" IS NULL AND "moderation_actions"."action" IN ('hide', 'hide_chat') AND "moderation_actions"."reason" = 'spam')

moderation_actions_target_check.name: moderation_actions_target_check
moderation_actions_target_check.value: ((((("moderation_actions"."action" in ('hide', 'unhide', 'delete', 'restore', 'dismiss_report', 'fix_entry', 'unfix_entry') and "moderation_actions"."target_entry_id" is not null) or ("moderation_actions"."action" in ('suspend', 'unsuspend', 'exclude_reactions', 'include_reactions', 'clear_display_name', 'restore_display_name', 'dismiss_display_name_report', 'clear_avatar', 'restore_avatar', 'dismiss_avatar_report') and "moderation_actions"."target_user_id" is not null)) and "moderation_actions"."target_village_id" is null and "moderation_actions"."target_chat_message_id" is null) or ("moderation_actions"."action" in ('fix_village', 'end_village', 'unfix_village', 'reopen_village', 'dismiss_village_report', 'clear_village_icon', 'restore_village_icon') and "moderation_actions"."target_village_id" is not null and "moderation_actions"."target_entry_id" is null and "moderation_actions"."target_user_id" is null and "moderation_actions"."target_chat_message_id" is null) or ("moderation_actions"."action" in ('hide_chat', 'unhide_chat', 'dismiss_chat_report') and "moderation_actions"."target_chat_message_id" is not null and "moderation_actions"."target_entry_id" is null and "moderation_actions"."target_user_id" is null and "moderation_actions"."target_village_id" is null)) and "moderation_actions"."target_media_id" is null) or ("moderation_actions"."action" = 'delete_media' and "moderation_actions"."target_media_id" is not null and "moderation_actions"."target_entry_id" is null and "moderation_actions"."target_user_id" is null and "moderation_actions"."target_village_id" is null and "moderation_actions"."target_chat_message_id" is null)

notifications_followed_thread_check.name: notifications_followed_thread_check
notifications_followed_thread_check.value: "notifications"."kind" <> 'followed_thread' OR ("notifications"."thread_id" IS NOT NULL AND "notifications"."entry_id" IS NOT NULL)

reports_target_check.name: reports_target_check
reports_target_check.value: ("reports"."entry_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("reports"."village_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("reports"."chat_message_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("reports"."display_name_user_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("reports"."avatar_user_id" IS NOT NULL)::int = 1

reports_chat_lang_check.name: reports_chat_lang_check
reports_chat_lang_check.value: ("reports"."chat_message_id" IS NULL AND "reports"."chat_lang" IS NULL AND "reports"."chat_author_id" IS NULL) OR ("reports"."chat_message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reports"."chat_lang" IS NOT NULL AND "reports"."chat_lang" in ('ja', 'en', 'fr', 'de', 'zh-Hant', 'zh-Hans', 'ko', 'th', 'vi'))

roles_lang_check.name: roles_lang_check
roles_lang_check.value: ("roles"."role" = 'operator' and "roles"."lang" is null) or ("roles"."role" = 'moderator' and "roles"."lang" is not null and "roles"."lang" in ('ja', 'en', 'fr', 'de', 'zh-Hant', 'zh-Hans', 'ko', 'th', 'vi'))

translation_reports_result_status_check.name: translation_reports_result_status_check
translation_reports_result_status_check.value: "translation_reports"."outcome" IS NULL OR ("translation_reports"."status" = 'resolved' AND "translation_reports"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

village_translations_ready_check.name: village_translations_ready_check
village_translations_ready_check.value: "village_translations"."state" <> 'ready' OR "village_translations"."name" IS NOT NULL OR "village_translations"."description" IS NOT NULL

villages_icon_kind_check.name: villages_icon_kind_check
villages_icon_kind_check.value: ("villages"."kind" <> 'personal' AND "villages"."language" IS NULL) OR ("villages"."icon_media_id" IS NULL AND "villages"."icon_action_id" IS NULL)

villages_personal_check.name: villages_personal_check
villages_personal_check.value: ("villages"."kind" = 'personal' AND "villages"."owner_id" IS NOT NULL AND "villages"."slug" IS NULL AND "villages"."language" IS NULL AND "villages"."source_lang" IS NULL AND "villages"."name" = '' AND "villages"."description" = '' AND NOT "villages"."system") OR ("villages"."kind" <> 'personal' AND "villages"."owner_id" IS NULL)

villages_language_active_check.name: villages_language_active_check
villages_language_active_check.value: "villages"."language" IS NULL OR ("villages"."system" AND "villages"."kind" = 'open' AND "villages"."slug" = lower("villages"."language") AND "villages"."ended_at" IS NULL)
